messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.06 (from 0.02); our mandate cap is 0.03, so Purser refused it. I've switched to Ridgeline (0.02, data 15 min old, but 11 of its last 20 tries were unavailable). Stockline at 0.06 would give us a 0.01 margin on a 0.07 sell price. If you want Stockline live data, the cap would need to rise to at least 0.06 (CFO decision). No action needed otherwise.

The rebalance is with the CFO as P-0001/P-0002. I recommended Option B: your cap goes to 0.06, your budget from 10.00 to 14.00 (taken from Treasury), and the query price from 0.07 to 0.10, which gives a 0.04 margin on Stockline. Until the CFO approves it, keep using Ridgeline at 0.02 under the current 0.03 cap.
